name: Mandalay
scopeLimits: The ranked WUP population-weighted point is a settlement locator, not a parcel identity, municipal boundary, or coverage guarantee. No full polygon geometry is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official national portal identifies Mandalay City Development Committee as the city map app operator and describes its land-management role, but the app's stated map functions cover roads, addresses, postal codes, wards and townships. No city cadastral register or public parcel-map service was verified.
technicalBlocker: The only city-specific official map found is described as a street/address locator, not a parcel viewer. Official-source searches did not identify a Mandalay cadastral map or public vector feature service.
remainingUncertainty: Whether Mandalay City Development Committee or another municipal department maintains a non-public cadastral/lease register or a separate city parcel viewer; the located government app description does not say.
nextStep: Search MCDC's own city-planning and land-management publications for a publicly documented parcel map; test only an anonymous bounded vector endpoint if a direct official service is identified.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: Official government app description was reviewed. It specifies address/location functions and gives mobile-app download links, but no browser viewer or parcel service URL. No HTML/JS route or API metadata was exposed in the official description.
